correctness.rationale: For all existing finite generalized quadrangles of symmetric order (q,q), q>=2, in the uncoloured equality-plus-adjacency language, reconstruct the rank-4 equivalence using girth 8, diameter 4 and distance-regular array {q+1,q,q,q;1,1,1,q+1}. The 5-by-5 distance-matrix recurrences compute each p^d_ab. Its nonzero support is parameter-independent by the stated factorized positivity in h=q-2 (the certificate is a finite symbolic identity, not a q=2,3 extrapolation). A one-vertex extension of any ordered triple is classified by clipped pair distances min(dist,3): adjacency masks of multiplicity 0,1,2,3 are decided by unique geodesics through length 3, triangle/hexagon exclusion, q+1>=3, and sufficient non-neighbours. Hence ordered pair rank-2 types are exactly the five distances 0..4; the distinction of 3 and 4 uses a (1,2) distance witness. All such types are realized from every root (the five distance spheres are positive), so rank-3 unary types and rank-4 sentence types agree. Rank-5 sentence 'a vertex with four distinct neighbours' separates W(3,2) degree 3 from W(3,3) degree 4. Independent fresh symplectic incidence enumeration built the 30- and 80-vertex graphs, reproduced 30 clipped triple types and the full same pair-distance support sizes 4,7,9,9,8; this is corroboration, not the general proof. Boundary excludes q=1 and sorted languages.

Future use includes logical classification of finite generalized polygons and distinguishing expressive power of bounded quantifier rank.
